name: Muse Image Text to Image
description: Muse Image generation with built-in web and image search grounding, billed per generated image.

MetaToolEnablement.description:
Muse Image's built-in grounding tools, all on by default. Turning them off trades
accuracy on real places, products, and current facts for speed.
MetaToolEnablement.title: MetaToolEnablement

num_images.description: Images to generate. Each one is billed.
num_images.title: Num Images

size.description: Shape of the output as "WxH". Only the ratio is read, never the magnitude: 16x9, 1920x1080 and 3840x2160 all render the same image, sized by the model. "auto" lets it pick the shape too.
size.title: Size

reasoning_strength.description: "high" refines over several passes; "low" returns after one, trading polish for speed. Same price either way.
reasoning_strength.title: Reasoning Strength

tool_enablement.description: Turn off the grounding tools the model runs while it works. All on by default.
